_about: Curator pins for scripts/_lib/es/parroquia.py: record slug → INE → {pliego spelling: IET Mapa de Parroquias spelling}; `_municipios` maps a pliego municipio name to its INE when GISCO's name differs. Keys starting with `_` are notes. A pin must name a parish that exists in the layer for that INE (a stale pin is logged and ignored). Every pin below was added from the 2026-09-24 probe's unmatched list, with the two spellings as its reason; a parish the layer does not carry at all (Ourense's Cabeza de Vaca / Santiago das Caldas / Tras do Hospital, folded into the city parish on the IET map) is left out, not pinned.

betanzos._note: Oza dos Ríos merged with Cesuras into Oza-Cesuras (INE 15902) in 2013; GISCO and the IET layer carry the merged name. Abegondo: the pliego's Castilianised Sarandóns / Vilacoba are the layer's Sarandós / Vilacova.

terras-do-navia._note: A Fonsagrada: the pliego's Galician San Martiño de Suarna is the layer's San Martín de Suarna. Navia de Suarna: the pliego's A Pobra de Navia is the layer's A Proba de Navia (the Galician normative spelling).

valle-del-mino-ourense._note: Cartelle: the pliego's bare San Tomé is the layer's San Tomé das Olas (the only San Tomé parish of Cartelle).

monterrei._note: The parent's delimitation is the two subzonas' text (section 9 of the documento único, PDO-ES-A1114-AM03), read whole once the MAPA zone — six whole municipios — gave way to its parishes; Riós' Castrelo de Abaixo / Castrelo de Cima are the layer's Castrelos de Abaixo / Castrelos de Cima, as pinned for the Ladera subzona.

monterrei-ladera-de-monterrei._note: Riós: the documento único's Castrelo de Abaixo / Castrelo de Cima are the layer's Castrelos de Abaixo / Castrelos de Cima.
